assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I25.10
There is a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service directly addresses the concern for intermittent arrhythmia noted in the clinical indication
The service provides documentation needed to support coverage eligibility for the non-emergency diagnostic monitoring service that SilverBridge Advantage requires to be pre-approved
